title: Saurer Intelligent Technology Co.
description:
[manufacturer] Saurer Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (SSE: 600545), operating as SAURER AG from its headquarters at Textilstrasse 9, Arbon, Thurgau, Switzerland, is a global textile machinery manufacturer founded in 1853 and controlled by China's Jinsheng Group since 2013. The company operates through subsidiaries including Saurer Spinning Solutions GmbH & Co. KG (Ubach-Palenberg, Germany), Saurer Technologies GmbH & Co. KG (Krefeld, Germany), Saurer Textile Solutions Pvt. Ltd (India), and entities in China, Czech Republic, Turkey, and Brazil.

The dataset comprises 540 GB exfiltrated across two German corporate file servers, capturing the company's complete operational infrastructure across HR/payroll, treasury/banking, financial shared services, internal audit, R&D engineering, production, insurance, works council, and IT administration:

<redacted>

Employee PII and HR data: Swiss payroll records (2023-2025) for SITAG and Saurer NL entities containing salary certificates with AHV (social insurance) numbers, pension contributions, and tax data. Senior Leadership Team and non-SLT employment contracts with compensation terms. UK subsidiary (Fibrevision, Macclesfield) salary and pension records (2024-2026) including a maternity certificate (special category health data under GDPR Art. 9), new starter forms with full onboarding PII, and a production pay database (.mdb). German works council (Betriebsrat) wage tables effective April 2026, Kurzarbeit (short-time work) agreements, camera surveillance agreements, and company pension documentation.

Financial and MNPI data: Unpublished draft HGB 2025 statutory annual accounts (Bilanz u. GuV) for Saurer Spinning dated 28.07.2026. A 63 MB Finance-Status master file from August 2026 containing real-time cash position. Complete treasury operations across 8+ banking partners (Deutsche Bank, UBS, Helaba, OLB, DZ Bank, BHF, Bank CIC) including bank account overviews, signatory authorities, MT940 electronic bank statements, credit facilities, trade finance pricing, and a 33 MB investor factbook. Transfer pricing documentation including the TP Masterfile, Deloitte advisory project, and intercompany agreements. Cash planning files (2023-2026) with weekly customer cash-in reports by region. HGB statutory accounts spanning 2016-2025 for all entities. Financial Shared Services covering accounts payable/receivable, general ledger, IFRS reporting, and PWC audit working papers.

Engineering IP: Over 63 GB of AUTOCORO open-end spinning machine R&D documentation including active codename projects (101_Luchs, 102_01_Gecko), test data, and machine parameters. Extensive SolidWorks CAD models (.sldprt, .sldasm) for textile machine components including spinning boxes, winding stations, rotors, and feed mechanisms using the company's Z-number parts system. ECAD/EPLAN P8 electrical engineering schematics and project databases. 68+ MDESIGN mechanical design databases covering bearings, gears, shafts, and welding calculations. Electronic Parts Catalog (ETK) H2 databases.

Privileged and audit material: Deloitte transfer pricing advisory work product. PWC audit working papers in Financial Shared Services. Internal Audit Germany project plans, follow-up databases, and project overviews. D&O insurance coverage terms and the complete insurance portfolio (Global Liability, Marine Cargo, Property/Business Interruption, legal expenses). 

Email archives and operational data: 73 Outlook PST files spanning 25+ customer countries (Bangladesh to Vietnam), treasury email archives, former employee mailboxes, and logistics/HR correspondence. AS400 data exports (Jan-Oct 2025) containing orders, accounts receivable/payable, general ledger accounts, and deliveries in monthly CSV archives.
